description: Each block alone at 4 -60 0 (cactus, chest, ender chest, brewing stand, fence, iron bars, glass pane, end portal frames without and with an eye, player head, anvil, carpet): sprint into it from the west, sprint-jump onto or over it, then drop onto its top and sneak to its east, south, west and north edges.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
